summary: CrewScope is an interactive educational web platform that simulates astronaut health monitoring during space missions. It provides a visual dashboard featuring simulated health indicators, mission alerts, and mission status information to demonstrate the importance of astronaut well-being in space environments. By combining web technologies and data visualization, CrewScope makes space health monitoring concepts accessible and engaging. The project is designed for educational purposes and does not use real astronaut medical data or provide medical diagnoses.
details:
CrewScope – Mission Health Simulation is an educational web-based project designed to explore astronaut well-being during space missions.

The project presents a visual dashboard that brings together simulated health indicators, mission alerts, and mission status information in one interface.

Its main goal is to make the topic of astronaut health monitoring easier to understand through an interactive and accessible digital experience.

CrewScope was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The interface uses a dark space-inspired design with navy, cyan, and purple colors to create a clear mission-control experience.

All displayed health indicators and mission data are fictional and simulated for educational purposes. CrewScope does not use real astronaut medical records, provide medical diagnoses, or support actual mission operations. It is an independent educational project and is not an official NASA system.
